review.outcome: The run delivered and returned the requested app, two passing tests and single checkpoint, successfully continuing the interrupted action, but retained stale knowledge and violated script-only progress reporting.

learnings.title: Retain the observed same-action continuation
learnings.evidence: S-1, S-2, S-10: events.jsonl:126-140 records one implementation-loop start, one exclusive-create product write, one checkpoint append, continuation, and completion against the same loop and action. The run trace records continuation at line 36 and implementation acceptance at line 38. result.json records one continuation and a completed delivery.
learnings.proposal: Add this corroborating attempt to LR-20261101-58f651. Preserve the existing script-owned recovery mechanism; do not introduce another hook path or claim cold-context recovery from this warm-session observation.
learnings.premise_note: The scripts determine the pending action and required callback; the model resumes only the work they identify.

missing_considerations.title: Reconcile verification claims when decisions remain unchanged
missing_considerations.evidence: S-11: delivered work/docs/shiploop/architecture.md:7 still says the product and hook sequence do not yet exist. environment.md:33 calls TC_1 the sole planned case, while lines 47 and 52 describe two cases and completed verification. The accepted document result says architecture needs no change because implementation matches AD-1 and AD-2; its Improve review reports no material documentation issue.
missing_considerations.proposal: Investigate refining the existing document reconciliation duty to examine changed verification status as well as changed architectural decisions. Update affected current sections from accepted evidence, preserving IDs, dated baseline facts and unresolved limits. Avoid blanket replacement of words such as planned or unverified.
missing_considerations.premise_note: The existing document stage and review remain script-selected; the model supplies the scoped documentation judgment.

optimizations.title: Make progress instructions consistently script-owned
optimizations.evidence: S-15, S-3: events.jsonl:33,77,116,142,168,200,279 contain model-composed progress. At line 278 the script supplies the handoff narrative, but line 279 substitutes a composed update. metrics.json reports 19 of 20 narratives shown verbatim. SKILL.md:294-309 combines verbatim narrative instructions with instructions to tell the user a line and briefly report milestones.
optimizations.proposal: Clarify those existing instructions and the status-display reference so progress always uses the script-rendered text under its display rule. Preserve answers to user questions, artifact delivery information, host-displayed status and unchanged-status suppression. Add no reporting stage or counter.
optimizations.premise_note: Scripts continue to determine both progress state and its wording; the model only presents the designated text.

discoveries.title: Warm continuation preserved the unfinished action

evidence.observation: The hook continued the existing implementation action, followed by verification and completion of the original loop without another product write or checkpoint append.
evidence.interpretation: The restored mechanism handled this deliberate early final message while retaining script ownership.

evidence.observation: The separate selected-package fixture passed active-loop and terminal-loop completion checks; the live run used one session.
evidence.interpretation: Fixture coverage and live active-loop recovery are useful but different evidence; neither establishes cold-context equivalence.

mission_anchor.challenge: No amendment is proposed; this also supports S-1 and S-10 within the observed path.

discoveries.potential_impact: Preserving the mechanism prevents premature termination or replay of partial work on this exercised path.
alternatives: The explicit checkpoint instruction and warm context may make this easier than an accidental interruption.
Terminal-loop recovery may behave differently with a live model than in the synthetic fixture.
discoveries.next_experiment: For the remaining live-coverage gap, interrupt after an inner loop becomes terminal but before its parent callback and verify exactly one original callback without replay. Treat that as narrow mechanism evidence; broader benefit requires the registered exposing-plus-generality comparison.
discoveries.proposal: Attach this attempt to the existing candidate lesson and preserve its scope limits; do not create a duplicate implementation proposal.

discoveries.title: Unchanged decisions concealed stale verification knowledge

evidence.observation: The delivered living files retain pre-implementation claims alongside completed verification and a two-case suite.
evidence.interpretation: A later reader must reconstruct which statements remain current.

evidence.observation: The document result justifies no architecture change by unchanged decisions, and Improve accepts the documentation without edits.
evidence.interpretation: The existing review may attend to decision changes while overlooking the transition from planned checks to observed evidence.

mission_anchor.challenge: This is a missed existing knowledge-maintenance obligation, not a request for additional living files or stricter section-notice gates.

discoveries.potential_impact: Stale verification claims could cause unnecessary rediscovery or incorrect confidence in a subsequent run; this run's delivered behavior remained correct.
alternatives: This may be a model oversight despite adequate existing guidance.
Some old statements may be intended as baseline history, but their scope and date are not clearly distinguished.
discoveries.next_experiment: Use a neutral document-stage fixture with unchanged decisions but newly observed checks, plus a genuinely unresolved boundary. Compare the existing duty with a targeted clarification; require current evidence to be reconciled while unresolved limits and stable IDs survive. A successful slice would still need full-run confirmation.
discoveries.proposal: Investigate a narrow refinement of the existing reconciliation duty before adding any new mechanism or checklist.

discoveries.title: Progress guidance permits an ambiguous reporting choice

evidence.observation: The handoff narrative was emitted but replaced by model-composed progress; nineteen other narratives were shown verbatim.
evidence.interpretation: The execution departed from S-15 even though most milestones followed it.

evidence.reference: skills/shiploop/SKILL.md:294-309; skills/shiploop/references/status-display.md:348-350 in the supplied executed source
evidence.observation: Verbatim narrative instructions coexist with less specific instructions to report milestones and provide one-line updates.
evidence.interpretation: The wording offers an avoidable ambiguity, although this run does not establish that it caused the model's choice.

mission_anchor.challenge: Align the cards with the existing script-rendered reporting obligation; do not authorize composed progress.

discoveries.potential_impact: Clearer instructions could prevent omitted narratives and redundant model narration without changing execution or review coverage.
alternatives: Host-level communication instructions may have influenced the composed updates.
The model may have disregarded an otherwise sufficient packet instruction.
discoveries.next_experiment: Exercise neutral milestone and non-milestone packets with and without host-displayed status. Check exact presentation, no duplicate unchanged status, and continued ability to answer user questions. Confirm live adherence separately; claim no token or time gain from this run.
discoveries.proposal: Replace the ambiguous progress wording with an explicit reference to the packet's script-rendered display rule, retaining its host-display and suppression behavior.

discoveries.title: The readable transcript merges distinct message phases

evidence.observation: One readable say line joins the checkpoint message and subsequent continuation commentary, which are separate raw events.
evidence.interpretation: A transcript-only reviewer could incorrectly conclude that the exact-message requirement failed.

evidence.observation: The rollout labels the checkpoint as final_answer, records hook injection, and labels the next message commentary.
evidence.interpretation: The underlying evidence resolves the apparent discrepancy; presentation should preserve that distinction.

mission_anchor.challenge: This is an evaluator presentation issue affecting inspection of S-2 behavior, not a ShipLoop failure or proposed floor change.

discoveries.potential_impact: Preserving message boundaries would reduce false review findings about exact callbacks and premature-final behavior.
alternatives: Keep the compact transcript but explicitly mark merged text and link each underlying event.
Render separate messages and show phase only where the host actually records it.
discoveries.next_experiment: Replay only this retained event sequence through the transcript renderer and require separate checkpoint and continuation messages, without inventing phase labels on hosts that omit them.
discoveries.proposal: Investigate preserving message boundaries and observed phases in readable exports as a separate evaluator change.

learning_retention.answer: Keep the existing append-only learning records and verbose operator-owned Git learning commits. No alternative state store is justified by this run.
proposals: Record this attempt under LR-20261101-58f651 with candidate identity, raw hook evidence, actual measurements, contrary evidence and scope limits; keep admission, implementation and qualification statuses separate.
After reviewer and judge work ends, the authorized operator should record the learning commit and exact review/judge binding. That work remains pending in this read-only review.
Preserve raw events and rollout phases alongside the readable export; the latter loses a distinction needed to assess this probe.

further_learning.answer: Useful gaps remain in cold recovery, live terminal-loop continuation and the usability of delivered knowledge in a later run.
proposals: Use S-6 stage-boundary and within-stage clear-context probes before claiming recovery equivalence or removing packet grounding.

Investigate A2's continued appearance as an open plan assumption despite later settlement evidence; distinguish historical declarations from current unresolved status without closing assumptions from model prose or criterion presence alone.
Inspect whether interpreter-written report plumbing is required by the interface or chosen by the host before proposing an S-4/S-5 mechanism change.
Keep one learning record per qualified candidate and exposing-plus-generality coverage, or explicitly narrow the claim; a successful replay alone cannot establish end-to-end benefit.

evaluation_criteria.answer: No new promotion floor is justified. Improve evidence interpretation and coverage within the existing clauses.
proposals: Retain known S-11 and S-15 violations beside the passing delivery verdict instead of treating a green product as full conformance.

Report mutation coverage, served-model identity, dollar cost and cold-context recovery as unobserved where applicable; do not infer them from successful completion.
Treat transcript-rendering repairs as evaluator experiments with their own boundary, never as evidence of a ShipLoop gain.
